## Demo 3 (sales): pipeline digest
Interest signals (event, webinar, call, mail, form) go through a **guardrail** (text from outside is untrusted), a transparent **score** (ICP fit, budget, decision maker, need, timing) and a **router** (opportunity, nurture, watch). The result is a digest for the weekly sales round.
**From the chat:** "Score these five contacts from the event" runs the tool `run_sales_pipeline_digest`, which posts `{"signals":[{"id":"INT-1","account":"...","source":"Event","industry":"Retail","region":"DACH","employees":800,"budget":"cycle","decisionMaker":"sponsor","need":"concrete","timing":"quarter","text":"..."}]}` to `/webhook/sales-pipeline-digest`. Without signals the six sample signals are used.
**By hand:** click *Execute workflow*. Nothing is sent or written; no credentials needed. The digest ends in "draft, never send".
